shared_elements: human face carved on an upright monolithic stone block
heavy horizontal brow ridge across the face
flat area above the head suggesting a cap or headdress zone
vertical column-like stone body beneath the head
museum-lit stone sculpture with weathered/pitted surface
justification: Both are single upright stone blocks whose upper portion is worked into a frontal human face with a heavy straight brow, deep eye sockets and a broad projecting nose beneath a flat cap-like top, and both are photographed as free-standing museum pieces. The rendering differs sharply, however: A is coarse, deeply eroded and modelled in bulky mass with no ornament visible in the crop, while B is a smoother dark monolith covered with crisp shallow incised motifs — discs, a chest circle and horizontal bands — that have no counterpart in A.
